_comment: Deterministic mock scenario written in MONITORING DAYS, not dates. Day 1 is the real date the first health check ran; Day N is that date + N-1. Nothing is generated ahead of time: each day's state is only produced when that day's check actually runs. Every failure class the tool must detect appears at least once. 'operator_actions' are scripted mock-operator responses logged on the day of detection; their effect appears in later days' events.
